description: Fires in the opening (5-7 stones) when the opponent's last stone went in columns 0-4, strongest in centre column 3, helped by opponent stones in columns 4-5 and mine in column 0. Also fires late (37+ stones) when the last stone went in column 5 or 6. Early last moves in columns 5-6 and most mid-game positions do not fire it.
effect: none measurable: forcing it to max or to zero changes no column's probability by even 0.01 (5 positions tested)
notes: Layer 0. Dev F1 0.423 (P 0.30, R 0.74), AUROC 0.84, sim share 0.73. A mid-game branch (ply 19-28, left columns) raised recall but cut F1 to 0.19. Adding a stone-composition count hurt (F1 0.39). Mid-game column preference flips with ply parity depending on the game, which looks like a sequence-position x last-token interaction. Earlier move order does not matter. Synthesis only ties the dev max (0.014). No steering effect. Possibly a random direction or a mixture.
